column1: # Cue words for context-cued numbers (languages/cues.py); format in hu/cues.tsv.
# A number right after a cue is masked as its type even when its check digit fails; a "-"
# cue names a number that is not personal data and ends the window. Russian nouns change
# their ending by case: a trailing "*" covers the endings that keep the stem; forms whose
# stem changes are listed one by one. Matching ignores case and accents (ё = е).
